headers.comment: Hashed filenames, so the content at a given URL can never change. Cache it for a year.

The entry point must always be revalidated, or a returning visitor sits on a stale build after a deploy. Listed twice on purpose: header globs are matched against the REQUESTED path, so "/" never matches "/index.html" even though the rewrite resolves to it.
Crawler files change with the content and are tiny; an hour keeps them fresh.
Link unfurlers re-fetch this often; a day is plenty and keeps shares fast.
